items.source: obj - the object to check
items.translation: obj - 要检查的对象

items.source:
Optimized to skip sorting for lists with size 0 or 1,
in order to avoid unnecessary array extraction.
items.translation: 优化为跳过大小为 0 或 1 的列表排序，以避免不必要的数组提取。

items.source: the order value, or Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE as fallback
items.translation: 订单值，或作为回退使用 `Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE`。

items.source: The default implementation checks against the given OrderComparator.OrderSourceProvider using findOrder(Object) and falls back to a regular getOrder(Object) call.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查给定的OrderComparator.OrderSourceProvider，使用findOrder(Object)，并回退到常规的getOrder(Object)调用。

items.source: PriorityOrdered objects will be sorted with higher priority than plain Ordered objects.
items.translation: PriorityOrdered 对象的优先级将高于普通 plain Ordered 对象。

items.source: The default implementation checks against the Ordered interface through delegating to findOrder(Object). Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现通过委托给findOrder(Object)来检查Ordered接口。可以在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: Any object that does not provide its own order value is implicitly assigned a value of Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, thus ending up at the end of a sorted collection in arbitrary order with respect to other objects with the same order value.
items.translation: 任何未提供自身顺序值的对象，都会被隐式分配一个值为 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE 的值，因此最终会位于排序后的集合末尾，且相对于其他具有相同顺序值的对象，其排列顺序是任意的。

items.source: The default implementation checks against the Ordered interface. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查 `Ordered` 接口。可在子类中重写。

items.source: The default implementation always returns null. Subclasses may override this to give specific kinds of values a 'priority' characteristic, in addition to their 'order' semantics. A priority indicates that it may be used for selecting one object over another, in addition to serving for ordering purposes in a list/array.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回 null。子类可以重写此方法，为特定类型的值赋予“优先级”特性，同时保留其“顺序”语义。优先级表示在用于列表/数组排序的同时，还可用于在多个对象中选择其中一个。

items.source:
Objects that have the same order value will be sorted with arbitrary
ordering with respect to other objects with the same order value.
items.translation: 具有相同顺序值的对象，其相对于其他具有相同顺序值的对象的排序将是任意的。
